case: a finding counter read six cold-read reports and counted five of them as empty
provenance: Failure 1 of the four the user named on 2026-09-23. The live counter read six reports and reported 72 findings where the true number was 176; three whole reports, one of them 17 KB, counted as empty, because the reviewers numbered their findings in four markdown shapes and the counter's pattern knew one. The reports are nedlern@ned-box:/home/nedlern/nedschorus-logs/cold-read-records/2026-09-15-handoff-system-overview-3/ and a copy sits in the gitignored cold-read-records/ tree of a Mac checkout. The corpus beside this fixture is those six reports' finding-heading lines, in the shapes their reviewers used, so the failure reproduces from a clone: 33 counted, 173 present, five reports of 17 to 40 findings each counted as 0. The command and its result below were run in this worktree on 2026-09-23; the count lines are sorted, because BSD grep emits them in no fixed order.
